memberdef.name: solve_linear1_ode

briefdescription.para: 求解一阶线性 ODE：dy/dx + P(x)*y = Q(x)

parameterdescription.para: Optional assumption context. When provided and the dependent variable y is known Positive, the solver prefers positive solution branches. When a coefficient is known NonZero, the solver skips zero-coefficient degenerate case checks. When nullptr, behavior is identical to the unparameterized call.
